value.rationale: The analysis studies a precise mathematical objective mismatch in the cited method: Frobenius-optimal pinning controls neither the number of raw stochastic probes nor its asymptotic ratio to a near-Frobenius-optimal alternative. The sharp 3x3 phase boundary and n-dimensional arbitrarily-small-surrogate-sacrifice family answer a concrete algorithm design question. Accepted-step results miss the cost because the rejection loop is outside the iteration count. No general elapsed-computation bound, broader algorithm impossibility, or new coupon-collector identity is claimed.
